facts.fact: Zambian Business Times, citing an official report (the Auditor General's 2025 report), says the legacy ZILMIS land system was replaced by ZILAS, with 982 property records missing after migration.

systems.country_label: Zambia Integrated Land Management Information System (legacy)

facts.fact: Zambian Business Times reports, citing an official report, that the legacy ZILMIS land system was migrated to the Zambia Integrated Land Management System (ZILAS), with 982 records missing, and that users face intermittent outages.
